title: JNKY Quad Cart
description: JNKY Quad Cart adds a rugged, custom drivable quad cart to Minecraft for Fabric 1.21.1. Built for exploring your world in style, it features a chunky off-road design with bright lights and a compact low-profile body.
body:
JNKY QuadCart adds a custom drivable quad cart vehicle to Minecraft for Fabric 26.2.1, The mod gives players a rugged off-road style cart with a compact body, large tires, bright front lights, and a unique design that fits survival, creative, and showcase worlds.

The purpose of the mod is to add a fun vehicle option for exploring terrain, traveling around builds, and giving Minecraft worlds a custom rideable cart with its own look and feel.

Has a controller that lets you call back/away like a chest/storage, you can transport animals/players its a three seater you can ride solo with two animals or two friends one animal or just three friends to travel. You fuel it with a custom fuel, can hitch animals/mobs to the quad with lead, can ride on water/hydroplane (read the guidebook)
